title: Cycle Count for Retail Store Operations
objective: Enable store associates to perform accurate and efficient inventory cycle counts using mobile devices, reducing count time by 40% and improving inventory accuracy to 98%.
businessValue: Accurate inventory drives sales by reducing out-of-stocks and overstock situations. Cycle counts performed efficiently allow associates to spend more time serving customers while maintaining inventory integrity.
inScope: Mobile-first cycle count initiation and execution
Real-time count submission and variance tracking
Integration with existing inventory management system
Offline mode for areas with poor connectivity
assumptions: Store associates have access to mobile devices with cameras
Backend inventory API is available and documented

modules.name: Count Assignment
modules.description: Allows managers to create and assign cycle count tasks to associates, with scheduling and priority management.

features.name: View Assigned Counts
features.description: Associates can see their assigned cycle count tasks with due dates, locations, and estimated time.

flows.name: View My Counts
flows.description: Associate views their assigned counts for the day
steps: View list of assigned counts sorted by priority
See count details including location, estimated items, and due time

edgeCases: No counts assigned for the day
Count assignment updated while viewing list
Multiple counts with same due time
successMetrics: Time to view assigned counts < 3 seconds
100% of assigned counts visible to associate

features.name: Create Count Task
features.description: Managers can create new cycle count tasks by selecting locations, products, or categories.

flows.name: Create Location-Based Count
flows.description: Manager creates a count for a specific store location
steps: Assign to associate or leave unassigned

modules.name: Count Execution
modules.description: Core counting functionality including product scanning, quantity entry, and count completion.

features.name: Scan and Count
features.description: Associates scan product barcodes and enter counted quantities with automatic variance calculation.

flows.name: Standard Scan Flow
flows.description: Associate scans and counts products in sequence
steps: System identifies product and shows expected quantity
Enter actual counted quantity using number pad
System shows variance if count differs from expected
Repeat for next product or tap 'Complete Section'

flows.name: Manual Product Lookup
flows.description: Associate finds product without barcode scan
steps: Enter product name, SKU, or description

edgeCases: Product not in expected location list

features.name: Offline Counting
features.description: Allow counting to continue when network is unavailable, with automatic sync when connectivity returns.

flows.name: Offline Count Sync
flows.description: System handles offline counting and synchronization
steps: When network returns, show sync indicator
Confirm sync completion with success message

successMetrics: Zero data loss in offline mode

modules.name: Variance Management
modules.description: Track and manage inventory variances discovered during counts.

features.name: Variance Review
features.description: Review and investigate significant inventory variances before finalizing counts.

flows.name: Review High Variance Items
flows.description: Associate reviews items with significant variance
steps: After count completion, view variance summary
See list of items with variance > threshold
Add variance reason from predefined list
Submit final count with variance notes

edgeCases: Manager override required for large variances
